thesis: Applied Materials makes and services wafer fabrication equipment used to manufacture semiconductors. **[Fact]** Customers are foundry, logic, memory, and packaging fabs worldwide. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$28.4 billion** (+4.4% versus FY2024); operating profit **$8.3 billion** (29.2% margin); net income **$7.0 billion**. **[Fact]** The company reports two segments: **Semiconductor Systems** (**$20.8 billion**, 73% of revenue) and **Applied Global Services** (**$6.4 billion**, 22%). **[Fact]** Owner cash in FY2025 was **$7.05 per share** after **$8.0 billion** operating cash flow and **$2.3 billion** capital spending, on **808 million** diluted shares.
why_market_wrong: There is **no dated predictive attribute** (HK: **none**). **[Inference]** The market treats AMAT as a structural AI-infrastructure winner whose earnings will compound far above mid-cycle WFE growth, justifying a **~1.2%** free-cash-flow yield at **$588.66**. **[Inference]** The alternative view is that FY2025 and FY2026 results already reflect a strong WFE upcycle, and a normalized mid-cycle owner-cash path cannot support the current multiple without heroic decade-long growth assumptions.
